features.name: ho__z_price
features.description: Z-score of the last trade price using externally provided baseline mean and standard deviation.

features.name: ho__log_return
features.description: Logarithmic return of the last trade price relative to the previous record.

features.name: ho__price_accel
features.description: Second-derivative proxy of price returns computed as the first difference of log returns.

features.name: ho__volume_z
features.description: Z-score of executed volume relative to baseline volume statistics.

features.name: ho__ob_imbalance_z
features.description: Z-score of order-book depth imbalance using baseline mean and standard deviation.

features.name: ho__pca1_book
features.description: First PCA component of top-of-book depth vector using pre-fitted loadings only.

features.name: ho__interaction_of_volume_spread
features.description: Interaction term capturing executed volume multiplied by level-1 spread.

features.name: ho__return_signed_volume_interaction
features.description: Product of tick return and signed trade volume for directional flow sensitivity.

features.name: ho__return_over_spread
features.description: Tick return normalized by level-1 spread to account for microstructure friction.

features.name: ho__imbalance_times_return
features.description: Order-book depth imbalance multiplied by tick return to emphasize imbalance-aligned moves.

features.name: ho__filtered_mid_price
features.description: Ehlers-filtered mid price using fixed coefficients and past-only recursion.

features.name: ho__book_flow_interaction
features.description: Order-book imbalance interacted with signed orderflow.

features.name: ho__normalized_impact
features.description: Impact per unit volume normalized by contemporaneous market regime liquidity score.

features.name: ho__signed_volume_ema
features.description: Exponential moving average of signed volume using a fixed, pre-defined alpha.
